arch: phoenix contexts per domain - web stays thin
GenServers own state, tasks own work - never both
ecto changesets at boundary - invalid data never reaches repo
umbrella apps for bounded contexts - deploy independently
description: Write concurrent Elixir with OTP discipline, changesets, and ExUnit proof. Use for any Elixir code or review.
idioms: pattern match function heads over conditionals
name: elixir-code
pitfalls: rescuing everything - let supervisors handle it
unbounded process spawning - use pools or backpressure
large binaries copied - mind binary handling

sample.code:
def total(%{items: items}) do
  Enum.reduce(items, 0, fn %{cents: c}, acc -> acc + c end)
end

style: mix format enforced, credo strict in CI
function heads ordered specific to general
moduledoc and doc on public functions
testing: ExUnit plus Mox for boundaries; property tests for parsers.
triggers: setting up Mix, Credo, or ExUnit
